title: Engine Weights — Gaia's Rendering Stomach
philosophy: Engines are weights. Just like ollama pulls model weights for inference, Gaia pulls engine weights for rendering. AGPL/MIT/GPL engines are free food. Eat them all.

godot_4.7.2.note: C# does NOT work in WASM. Must use GDScript or GDExtension (Rust!) for web export.

gdre_tools_2.7.4.purpose: Reverse engineering — unpack .pck files, decompile scenes/scripts

key_patterns.crt_shader: barrel distortion + circular mask + scanlines shimmer + wibble + radial rotating vignette
key_patterns.circle_selector: 26 letters in 3D ring, knob rotates, petal textures per character
key_patterns.flipper_digit: upper/lower mesh halves flip like airport departure boards, SmoothDamp animation
key_patterns.story_controller: 2380-line brain using Ink narrative engine, binds C# externals for game state
key_patterns.code_format: 2 letters + 2 numbers (AJ30, BD49, CC79), validated by regex ^[A-Za-z]{2}-?\d{2}$
key_patterns.card_system: documents displayed in card_view with sections, rows, quotes, images, links
key_patterns.notebook: SHIFT key opens notes, tracks collected titles, cross-references
key_patterns.voice: SPACE key for voice/intercom, VOController manages audio queues

blender.note: Too large for WASM but Python API can drive from eastGate

bevy.purpose: Rust ECS game engine — pairs DIRECTLY with primals
bevy.note: Best candidate for petalTongue native rendering

wasm_path.step_3: Create GDScript project (NOT C# — C# can't export to WASM)
wasm_path.step_4: Port CRT shader (works directly — shaders are cross-platform)
wasm_path.step_6: Export to WASM → serves from gate :8443 at /tube-godot
wasm_path.step_7: OR use GDExtension with Rust → primals talk directly to Godot
wasm_path.alt_path: Bevy + wgpu in Rust → compile to WASM → petalTongue IS the engine
